name: UI/UX Pro Max
description: Selects an intentional interface system from product context instead of relying on generic visual guesses.
constraints: Select styles from the product, audience and platform; do not default to fashionable effects.
Do not add a framework, font dependency or component library unless the project already permits it.
Text, controls and layouts must survive localization, zoom and narrow viewports.
guidance: Derive the interface pattern, visual style, palette, typography, spacing and interaction behavior from the product category and user task.
State the chosen design direction and the anti-patterns to avoid before implementing substantial UI.
Use a compact token system for colors, type, spacing, radius, shadows and motion.
Design information density, navigation and feedback for the target platform rather than copying a desktop layout everywhere.
Check contrast, focus, reduced motion, long text, touch targets, empty states, loading, errors and responsive breakpoints.
completion_checks: The product context clearly explains the selected pattern and visual direction.
Colors, typography, spacing, radius and states form a consistent system.
The interface handles desktop, mobile, zoom and longer content without clipping.
Accessibility and interaction states are implemented rather than described only.
The result avoids the identified industry and platform anti-patterns.
